title.narrative: Civil Society Organizations as Actors of Governance and Development II

description.narrative:
The action aims to contribute to an inclusive, participatory, empowered, and independent civil society which is

pivotal for promoting a democratic space in partner countries. The action also seeks to promote an inclusive and

open dialogue with and between Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) at local, regional, and global levels. The

proposed research on nine priority themes will contribute to meeting the specific objectives (SOs) of the action
